title: Unsquished Nether
description: A simple mod that lets you customize the Nether scale compared to the Overworld by choosing the exact division or multiplication ratio.
body:
This mod lets you fully customize how distance scaling works between the Nether and the Overworld.
Instead of being limited to the default vanilla ratio, you can choose your own multiplication or division values to control how far players travel when moving between dimensions.

Whether you want a more balanced survival experience, faster long-distance travel, or a completely different world progression system, this mod gives you full control over the Nether travel scale.

It is designed to be simple, lightweight, and easy to configure, making it useful for vanilla-like servers, modpacks, custom SMPs, and experimental gameplay setups.
